name: expiry-predicate-single-source
prompt: session.go decides expiry inline in Get with `now.Sub(session.LastSeen) > ttl`. Introduce a single named method on Store: func (s *Store) expired(session Session) bool that returns true when the session's idle time exceeds the ttl, and make Get the only caller today. The refactoring must not change any behavior: Get still reports expired sessions as not found and still drops them. Add nothing else; this is a pure extract-method refactor so later changes have one place to touch.
